question: Does removing the frozen imitation prior improve PPO/FCSRL control in the same e50 environment?
interpretation: Ablation of the additive prior throughout training, not only initialization; no behavior imitation penalty existed in e50.
cost: NH4>4 plus max(DO)>2 counts, sum limit12; e50 conditions, not e54 limits6/6
prior_off: Load the same prior network and zero its final layer without consuming RNG; keep actor/critic/encoder initialization and optimizer unchanged. Initial action mean0 corresponds to4500m3/h.
primary: Paired off-minus-on air_m3, nh4_cost, do_cost for each method separately
exploratory_joint_screen: All three primary means strictly decrease; at least4/5 seeds have all three nonincreasing; both mean excess integrals and mean worst-day NH4/DO do not increase; number of cost-feasible seeds does not decrease. Numerical equality tolerances: air0.001m3, costs1e-9, integrals1e-8. No official adoption from this screen alone.
reuse_baseline: Verify input hashes and shared training sources against e50; prior-on seed0 first2 updates must reproduce original logs for PPO and FCSRL before main launch.
